user_saw: After a gateway restart, the agent could send a temporary browser link instead of showing the widget on the session dashboard.
summary: The fix aligns widget instructions with the presentation surface available on the current turn and tells the agent how to open a pinned widget’s dashboard tab.
reasoning: The dashboard’s instruction to keep one-off visuals inline predated pinned-only authoring for recovered Control UI turns. The parent of #139705 limited the pinned-only exception to scheduled turns, and #139705 added `options?.pinnedWidgetAuthoring === true` to expose it to recovered turns without a live renderer. That new usage exposed the conflict with existing dashboard guidance, and the later Visualize skill repeated the inline instruction.
